  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_mutation) AS year,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY prix_m2) AS median_prix_m2
  FROM dvf.ventes

    AND type_bien = 'Appartement'

  GROUP BY year
)

  (SELECT median_prix_m2 FROM yearly_medians WHERE year = 2025) / 
  (SELECT median_prix_m2 FROM yearly_medians WHERE year = 2021) - 1 AS growth_rate,
  POWER(
    (SELECT median_prix_m2 FROM yearly_medians WHERE year = 2025) / 
    (SELECT median_prix_m2 FROM yearly_medians WHERE year = 2021),
    1/4
  ) - 1 AS cagr
